posts.text:
Very serious situation unfolding across the Texas Hill Country.

Flash Flood Emergencies have been issued in multiple areas, water rescues and evacuations are underway, and rivers and creeks are rising rapidly. 

If you are in the affected areas, heed all local alerts immediately, stay off the roads, and move to higher ground if instructed. Don’t underestimate the danger: conditions can change in minutes.
posts.summary: Urges residents to prioritize safety during flash flood emergency

posts.text: Floodwaters are rising quickly on roads and at low water crossings across Kerr, Gillespie, Real, and Kendall Counties. If you do not absolutely need to be on the roads, stay home. Emergency personnel are actively responding. Never drive through floodwaters. #TX21
